title: California ticket resale cap bill falters in State Senate
summary: A bill that proposed to introduce a ticket resale cap in California has failed to pass, with live industry figures calling it a “disappointing outcome”. The bill (AB 1720) stalled in the State Senate yesterday (13 August), meaning its aims to limit resale price to 110% of face value, as well as limiting transaction fees charged by platforms, will not take effect. The proposed regulations would have applied only to tickets for events in venues below 3,000 capacity. title: Serbian live sector ‘under threat’ amid ongoing protests
summary: Live music industry figures in Serbia have said the country’s sector is “under threat” as they claim artists known to support ongoing student protests are increasingly “blacklisted” from festivals and venues receiving government funding.
